text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible too, Mejiro
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! You two did great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although we lost to Mejiro Ryan, we still
did
incredibly well on the grand stage of
the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for giving 110 percent out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Did I finally earn my spot as your big
sister?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have never not looked up to you as my
older
sister. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who should be thanking
you. If it
weren't for our rematch, I
wouldn't have realized
how insufficient
my resolve was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude. Thank you,
Ryan. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to you, I feel as though I've
learned
something... The way I ought to
be as a Mejiro.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, although the Takarazuka Kinen has
come to
a close...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Competing with Ryan has allowed me to
see my
next goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My next objective shall be the autumn
Tenno
Sho, following my win in the
spring—the Twin
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is a feat yet to be achieved by anyone
in the
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that Grandmother has entrusted me
with the
task...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I want to show her, and everyone else in
my
family, a new path forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, without fail!
choice_data_list_en: Let's show them we can achieve it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fire burns in Mejiro McQueen's eyes as
she sets
her sights on this new
goal—successive wins in the
spring and
autumn Tenno Sho.
